answer:
The CREATE INDEX command by default creates B-tree indexes.

The other index types are selected by writing the keyword USING followed by the index type name.

citations.title: textsearch-indexes
citations.text:
GIN indexes are the preferred text search index type.  As inverted
   indexes, they contain an index entry for each word (lexeme), with a
   compressed list of matching locations.  Multi-word searches can find
   the first match, then use the index to remove rows that are lacking
   additional words.  GIN indexes store only the words (lexemes) of tsvector values, and not their weight labels.  Thus a table
   row recheck is needed when using a query that involves weights.
